# Pi Mobile — source map for code agents

Read AGENTS.md and the active goal loop-develop/current-todo/001-todo.md before changing code. This repository is a mobile window onto the SAME running Pi in Orca; tests must not reload/interrupt it or send paid prompts. Billy explicitly authorized the 0.6.004 release, push and APK delivery to Парилка228 after final local verification. Do not deploy or alter the running Pi/Orca/gateway.

Product/version state: README.md (v0.6.004 Kotlin/Compose; release checks and physical-device limits in docs/release-0.6.004.md). Truthful architecture map: docs/architecture.md. Exact current class ownership: architecture/owners.json; feature passports: architecture/capsules/README.md. Visual references: docs/ui-baseline/README.md and immutable PNGs/manifest.json. Wire semantics/security: docs/protocol.md, docs/setup.md; release checks: docs/verification.md.

Android (android/app/src/main/java/ru/billyhargrove/pimobile): PiApp composes the process; MainActivity.kt composes features/catalog/CatalogSession (confirmed scoped commands, lifecycle generations) and CatalogScreen (Compose catalog/drawer/grouped settings), Kotlin/Compose ArchiveSheet and UsageCards. ChatActivity.kt is a Kotlin lifecycle/platform shell for features/chat/ChatSession (injected transport, canonical state, scoped ACK/control/history/config, epochs/follow-tail), ChatOutbox (receipts, retained drafts and explicit retry/restore) and Compose ChatScreen (header, transcript, attachments/skills/composer/delivery). OrchestrationActivity.kt owns Compose workflow/agent drill-down and consumes ui/PiTranscript without optional command actions. TranscriptPresentation is the shared presentation policy; old chat Java widgets/adapter/XML are removed. EffortSlider.kt is the Compose brain control shared by both bounded model sheets. PiTheme owns the neutral palettes/default content color. All production Android source is Kotlin. Markwon/LaTeX and image zoom remain bounded native leaves; model/effort/dictation/document/update containers render Compose in owned platform modal hosts. Legacy screen XML/adapters are removed. Integrated Node/JVM/build and all synthetic UI scenarios have passing coverage, including focused fixes, display/motion checks and actual read-only relay. In-place upgrade/rollback retains encrypted settings/outbox; physical-device acceptance remains open. core/net/store/media retain existing contracts and private data. Read current tests/owners/passports before editing; no permanent dual implementations. Billy's six ChatGPT screenshots and effort-slider video are the authorized design direction (goal/slice004); immutable UI baseline remains a behavior/before reference.

Host: server/gateway.mjs is composition root for HTTP/WS/Unix bridge; server/command-policy.mjs validates bounded commands, server/message-projection.mjs sanitizes transcript rows, server/media-cache.mjs bounds image bytes, server/session-projection.mjs sanitizes public configuration and snapshot frames; server/orchestration.mjs owns bounded read-only workflow/agent storage; extension/mobile.ts interfaces with Pi; contracts/agent-transcript.mjs contains pure transcript projection shared between server and extension. Neither runtime imports the other's implementation. Do not alter live gateway or Pi processes for validation.

Gates: npm run quality (Node tests, ownership/import boundaries, screenshot hashes), then android/gradlew testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug assembleDebugAndroidTest with JDK17 and API35 SDK. ADB Android UI tests do not dispatch prompts. Run final checks after the rewrite, then focused checks for concrete failures. Release 0.6.004 is explicitly authorized; preserve the certificate and verify actual GitHub/Telegram artifacts. Physical-device acceptance is still required for the full goal. Architecture guards must grow with ownership changes, not be bypassed.
